Container.Name: Zilcho-Subs
Container.Overview: Make subtitles and song lyrics for your own media library, on your own server. Zilcho Subs listens to a video's audio with a local Whisper speech model and writes a selectable .srt track next to it (Jellyfin and most players pick it up), with optional offline translation into other languages. It can also translate existing .srt files and make line- or word-synced .lrc lyric files for music. Runs on the CPU; nothing is uploaded to a cloud service. Speech models and translation packs download only when you ask. Videos, songs and your own subtitle or lyric files are never changed. Set a Web UI password, then open the web UI and follow the first-run steps in the README.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: subtitles captions srt lyrics lrc karaoke whisper transcription translation jellyfin
Container.Requires: A Linux x86-64 server. The default container limit is 2 CPUs and 6 GB of memory; larger speech models need more memory and run slower on the CPU. Models are downloaded into App Data (from about 75 MB for tiny to about 3 GB for large-v3).

Config.Name: Media Library
Config.Description: Your final imported media library (movies, TV, anime and music). Subtitles and lyrics are written next to the files. Example: /mnt/user/data/media

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent settings, SQLite queue, models and transcript cache

Config.Name: Web UI Password
Config.Description: Set a unique password, at least 12 characters. Do not expose the UI directly to the internet.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Owner UID for app data and new subtitle files

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Group GID; match your media permissions

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used by the processing schedule

Config.Name: File creation mask
Config.Description: Permissions for newly generated files; existing media permissions are never changed
